File: src/export/scheduler.tsx

Fix the weekly export scheduler calculation so that schedules created on the day of the cadence (e.g. Monday) calculate their first run for the same day when created before the run time, rather than skipping to the following week.
args.title: Fix weekly scheduled export to send on the first matching day
